## Question 1

Write a function (from scratch!) to perform K-Nearest Neighbors classication (two-classes only) and
K-Nearest Neighbors regression. Demonstrate your function by applying it to real or simulated data
sets and comparing results to built-in functions in R or Python. How do results change as you use
different values of K?

```{r q1, echo=TRUE, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.2}
library(kknn)
library(class)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#PARAMETERS
k<- 5
N<-500
split_tr<- 0.8

#Generate data with two classes:
set.seed(123)
class1 <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(N, mean = 5, sd = 1), x2 = rnorm(N, mean = 5, sd = 1), class = 1,target = rnorm(N))
class2 <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(N, mean = 7, sd = 1),x2 = rnorm(N, mean = 7, sd = 1),class = 2,target = rnorm(N))
data <- rbind(class1, class2)
#Visualize data points
ggplot(data, aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = factor(class))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()

# Split the data
num_train <- round(split_tr * nrow(data))
index <- sample(1:nrow(data), num_train)
train_data <- data[index, ]
test_data <- data[-index, ]
# Visualize split data
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = train_data, aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = "Training")) +
  geom_point(data = test_data, aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = "Test")) +
  labs(color = "Split Data") +
  theme_minimal()

#FROM SCRATCH
# KNN Classification 
knn_classification_scratch <- function(train_data, test_data, k) {
  predictions <- vector("integer", length(test_data))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(test_data)) {  
    distances <- sqrt((train_data$x1 - test_data[i, "x1"])^2 + (train_data$x2 - test_data[i, "x2"])^2)
    sorted_indices <- order(distances)
    k_nearest_classes <- train_data[sorted_indices[1:k], "class"]
    predictions[i] <- as.integer(as.factor(k_nearest_classes) %>% summary() %>% which.max())
  }
  
  return(predictions)
}
predicted_classes_s <- knn_classification_scratch(train_data, test_data, k)
cat("Predicted Classes:", predicted_classes_s, "\n")

# KNN Regression (From Scratch)
knn_regression_scratch <- function(train_data, test_data, k) {
  predictions <- vector("numeric", length(test_data))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(test_data)) {  
    distances <- sqrt((train_data$x1 - test_data[i, "x1"])^2 + (train_data$x2 - test_data[i, "x2"])^2)
    sorted_indices <- order(distances)
    k_nearest_values <- train_data[sorted_indices[1:k], "target"]
    predictions[i] <- mean(k_nearest_values)
  }
  
  return(predictions)
}
predicted_s <- knn_regression_scratch(train_data, test_data, k)
cat("Predicted Values:", predicted_s, "\n")

#BUILT IN
# KNN Classification 
knn_model <- knn(train = train_data[, c("x1", "x2")], test = test_data[, c("x1", "x2")], cl = train_data$class, k = k)
predicted_classes_b <- as.integer(knn_model)
cat("Predicted Classes:", predicted_classes_b, "\n")

# KNN Regression 
knn_reg_model <- kknn(target ~ x1 + x2, train = train_data, test = test_data, k = k)
predicted_b <- knn_reg_model$fitted.values
cat("Predicted Values:", predicted_b, "\n")

print('ANSWER: As k increase,code from scratch give more similar results with the built-in functions')
```
